name: ZenML
tagline: ZenML is an open-source MLOps framework that helps data science teams build standardized, portable ML pipelines that run on any cloud or infrastructure. It provides abstractions for pipeline steps, artifact tracking, and integrations with 50+ MLOps tools to avoid vendor lock-in.
